text: Architecture plan and RRA hierarchy synchronized on 2026-07-26. Response values are fixed to Double with an owned primitive row-major ResponseBlock rather than a universal tensor; datasets split into pure FmriDataset metadata/planning and effectful OpenedDataset execution; DecodeConsistency is separate from reconstruction error; locality is axis-keyed; Phase 0 freezes numerical baselines and ADRs; runtime assembly, transactional publication, mechanical import guards, and stop gates now have explicit owners. Dependency order is unchanged and RRA 0 remains the first actionable slice.
